cleavage agent: The immunoprecipitated proteins were subjected to in-gel digestion with trypsin.
enrichment method: ILP1-GFP and GFP control proteins were immunoprecipitated by GFP-trap beads.
labeling: ILP1-GFP and GFP control proteins were immunoprecipitated by GFP-trap beads.
reduction reagent: protein extraction buffer (10% glycerol, 50 mM Tris–HCl [pH 8.0], 5 mM MgCl2, 150 mM NaCl, 0.25% NP-40 and 2 mM Dithiothreitol [DTT])
